children: Citi Group said U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent may reduce the size of long-dated government bond auctions and could even cancel issuance of 20-year debt. According to Sina Finance, Jason Williams, Citi's head of U.S. rates strategy, said the base case is that each 20-year and 30-year auction will be cut by $3 billion, with the funding raised through increased Treasury bill issuance.

He said the Treasury is expected to announce the move in its next quarterly refunding announcement on November 4. Citi strategists said in a report late Friday that clients should position for 20-year bonds to outperform 10-year notes and prepare for reduced or canceled 20-year issuance.

title: Citi Expects Bessent to Cut U.S. Long-Bond Auctions, Possibly Cancel 20-Year Sales
